crossRefs.note: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

translations.web: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
translations.bsb: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”
translations.kjv: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
translations.asv: Mine enemies speak evil against me, saying, When will he die, and his name perish?
